AI-produced mathematical text

Abstract
The smooth returns of the specified compact complex six-sphere families are calculated in
Θ7 = Z/28 with their actual physical circle, parameter closing and cusp fan. The original
shorter (3, 4) scalar family realizes every class by varying its basis fan; its class on the vertical
fan T2 is 26, refuting the previous scalar norm polynomial. The OS45 reference family has
class 3, and its positive parameter covers realize every class. The fixed-edge rule for the
specified page returns is multiplication by 7. Complete source and cap comparisons give the
OS49, E7 and E6 return sectors. For the selected E6 order-three source loop the physical
Jin pair is (−27, −12) and the all-fan class is −4 + 3(S −1)/2 −27(S2 −1)/8 modulo 28,
where S = x2 + xy + y2 and (x, y)t = P −1e2; its image has sixteen elements. The selected-
infinity loop has initial physical pair (−4, 8) and the full fourteen-odd-class fan image for
both complete cap progressions, M6 with m = 3l + 2 and M2 with m = 3l, including both
primitive norm signs and every retained finite character and annular reference. For the original
selected-I3 source loop, the quadratic M6 cap has initial physical pair (47, −4) and realizes
all twenty-eight classes by explicit native fan words. The full selected-height, signed-meridian
and proper cap-product comparison extends both integers and every native fan map to all
reduced M6 caps and both primitive norm signs. The M2 order-three source loop has physical
pair (−3, −12) throughout every stated good cap and both primitive norm signs. Its full fan
integer is −3(S −1)(S −3)/8, with the sixteen-element residue set displayed in the complete
proof. Each cap comparison uses the common strict scalar range with its specified reference.
The proofs retain the source, line, finite-character and normal maps through every fan change.
The physical dual-line comparison fixes the orientation, and an integral prism recurrence
computes the fan dependence. Historical checks, current re-derivations and exact certificate
executions are recorded separately for each statement. The remaining attachment problem is
stated with its precise scope.

The actual punctured compact six-sphere family has no proper Hausdorff complex-analytic
filling after a finite parameter cover. For its prescribed reference fan, the positive parameter-loop
return has class zero in Θ7. The reduced special-surface fillings and their homology retain the
exact scope of ??.
Proof.
1. Apply ?? to this actual punctured family and to each parameter map w = rN,
N > 0. Its obstruction allows arbitrary central components, multiplicities and singularities.
It therefore excludes the requested flat proper compact filling as well as its proposed finite
pullbacks. There is no central threefold of such a filling on which to evaluate the requested
characteristic numbers or topology.
2. The source and quotient maps of ?? construct proper flat fillings of the two reduced special
surfaces after w = s6. Extending their inclusions to the proposed compact threefold filling
would also require the order-three and order-four normal characters on the two-parameter
plumbing, with the prescribed central multiplicities, and the periodic gluing at infinity
recorded in ??. A proper total filling realizing those extensions is excluded by the first step.
The proved surface groups remain attached to the two constructed surface families.
3. The exact clutching map of proposition 2.1 reduces the reference return to the residue
(E10) at c0 = −i(M + 1). The complete orbit-knot computation in theorem 2.30, and the
explicit cap and integer-additivity calculation in corollary 2.34, evaluate that residue as
zero. Transport along a path of basepoints in the connected parameter disc conjugates the
return by its actual fibre identification. Its image in the abelian group Θ7 is unchanged,
proving the assertion for every basepoint with this reference fan and these fixed data.
The actual positive-loop smooth monodromy is zero. 2.30 proves this through an equivariant
orbit-knot integer; 2.31–2.34 give a second determination through an explicit spinc eight-
dimensional coboundary and direct index additivity. Their boundary-invariant and one-loop
arguments are independent; their actual annular representative and characteristic inputs are
shared and identified below. ?? excludes the specified descended analytic filling, so 2.39 records
that its requested Chern data are undefined. In this section MΦ is a closed seven-manifold,
whereas W8 denotes a compact oriented eight-manifold with boundary. The circle parameter has
positive orientation. On MΦ we use the orientation dθ ∧oXc; this is the boundary orientation
of a holomorphic family over a positively oriented disc. The statements below do not assign a
characteristic number to that excluded analytic filling.
